approved_by: user direction 2026-10-11: move increments +/-0.25 .. 2.5% in both directions, calls and puts for every increment (stock buys only), stop-losses 5 .. 50%, profit targets 10 .. 200%, holds 30 minutes .. 4 hours, every variant, SPY/QQQ. Reading rule fixed here before the run. UV1 and UV2 results were seen first
question: Over every combination of morning-move bucket, call or put, stop-loss, profit target, hold length, entry time, ticker and weekday, does any SPY/QQQ 0DTE option (or stock-buy) rule make money beyond what chance produces in a grid this size?

grid.move: m = close(t-1) / open(09:30 ET) - 1 at the entry minute t (UV1 signal A)
grid.entry_minutes: every 5 minutes from 09:45 ET (09:45, 09:50, ...) while entry + hold <= 15:59

option.rights: call and put in every bucket
option.contract: first strike OTM at the entry decision, same-day expiry (UV1/UV2 rule)
option.entry: first traded minute t .. t+5 (VWAP); none: no trade
option.stops: none, 5%, 10%, ..., 50% below the entry mid (11 levels)
option.targets: none, 10%, 20%, ..., 200% above the entry mid (21 levels)
option.monitoring: each traded minute's VWAP after the entry minute, relative to the entry mid; a stop or target triggers on the first minute that crosses it and exits at the VWAP of the next traded minute (the trigger minute's VWAP if none follows)
option.time_exit: if nothing triggers before t + hold: first traded minute t+hold .. t+hold+5, else last trade t+hold-5 .. t+hold+5, else 0
option.costs: buy mid x 1.05, sell mid x 0.95, $0.05/contract/side (user rule); mid = minute trade VWAP

grid.stock: buy only, entry VWAP at t, exit VWAP at t + hold, 1 bp per side; no stops or targets (a 5-50% move in SPY/QQQ within 4 hours essentially never occurs)
grid.cells: option: 2 tickers x 6 day groups (Mon..Fri, All) x 20 buckets x 2 rights x 11 stops x 21 targets x 8 holds x valid entry minutes; stock: the same without rights, stops and targets. A cell needs n >= 30 trades

reading_rule.null: 200 permutations per instrument (seed 20261011): session rows of the move matrix are shuffled (same shuffle for both tickers), reassigning buckets across days while keeping every return path, contract and weekday
reading_rule.gate: a dev cell is a candidate when t >= 2 and t exceeds the 95th percentile of the permutation maximum t over all cells of its instrument (family-wise 5%)
reading_rule.reported: count of cells with t >= 2 vs the permutation mean and 95th percentile; observed maximum t vs its permutation distribution; top cells; every cell with n >= 30 saved
reading_rule.confirmation: candidates only: 2026 mean > 0 at base cost with t >= 1
reading_rule.single_run: runs once and is reported whatever the outcome

honesty_notes: neighbouring cells (adjacent stops, targets, buckets, holds and entry times) share most of their trades, so cells are strongly correlated; the permutation maximum accounts for that
option history is two years (about 480 dev sessions); weekday x bucket cells are thin and many fall under n = 30
stop and target fills at the next traded minute's VWAP are a modelling choice; real stop orders on 0DTE options can fill worse in fast markets
